title: Ned University of Engineering and Technology Karachi Amendment Act 2020

sections.shortTitle: Ned University of Engineering and Technology Karachi Amendment Act 2020
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XVIII OF 2020
ACT XVIII OF 2020
NED UNIVERSITY OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY,
KARACHI (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2020
An Act to amend the NED University of Engineering
and Technology, Karachi Act, 1977
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV,
12th August, 2020]
NO.
PAS/LEGIS-B-15/2020, dated 12.8.2020.---The NED University of Engineering and Technology, Karachi (Amendment)
Bill, 2020 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 23rd July,
2020 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 05th August, 2020 is hereby
published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the NED
University of Engineering and Technology, Karachi Act, 1977, in the manner hereinafter
appearing;
It is
hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the NED University of Engineering and Technology, Karachi
(Amendment) Act, 2020.
(2) It shall
come into force at once.

of section 15 of Sindh Act No. III of 1977.---In the NED University of Engineering and Technology, Karachi Act,
